_comment: The press brake's build (PressBrake/README.md, 'Build order'): each stage after the frame and its materials, as its rig's parts draw them; read by Machines/Core/MachineBuildJson.cs (its schema) and kept by the shared machine base (docs/modeling/machine-base.md). One item a stage: the clamp screws with their tommy bars are one lot of the game's metal parts (a block; drawn in cupronickel whatever was fitted), the wearing edges an iron or steel plate (drawn in that metal). A hand machine: nothing wears. No block: the brake's construction record is its own in the recipe export, not the ore machines' generic one.
